descriptions.normal: Honey-roasted fowl. The honey and sweet flowers come together to compliment the tender fowl meat.
descriptions.suspicious: Honey-roasted fowl. The sweet flowers have been burnt off, revealing the bitter taste of the overcooked fowl.
descriptions.delicious: Honey-roasted fowl. Tender and sweet, the meat has perfectly fused with the honey, ensuring the only thing left of this dish will be the cleanly-picked bones.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 22% of Max HP and an additional 1200 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 20% of Max HP and an additional 900 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 24% of Max HP and an additional 1500 HP to the selected character.
